title: Preparation of Chemically Competent Cells
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7pnhmme

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL of LB medium with 1 mL of overnight culture and grow to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of overnight culture into 50 mL LB in a flask
Incubate at 37 °C at 225 rpm until OD600 = 0.6

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Processing
steps.instruction: Transfer the culture to a falcon tube and chill.

substeps.instruction: Transfer culture to 50 mL falcon tube
Incubate culture on ice for 10 minutes

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and resuspend them in magnesium chloride solution.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tube at 4 °C, 5000 rpm for 5 minutes
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 30 mL of 0.1 M magnesium chloride solution

steps.title: Second Centrifugation and Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and resuspend them in calcium chloride solution.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tube at 4 °C, 5000 rpm for 5 minutes
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 20 mL of 0.1 M calcium chloride solution

steps.title: Chill and Final Pelleting
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample on ice and perform a final centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sample on ice for 30 minutes
Centrifuge tube at 4 °C, 5000 rpm for 5 minutes

steps.title: Resuspend and Aliquot Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in a glycerol/calcium chloride mixture and aliquot for storage.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1.5 mL of cold mixture comprising 20% glycerol and 80% 0.1 M calcium chloride solution
Aliquot 60 µL of mixture into 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes

steps.title: Store Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Store the aliquoted competent cells at -80 °C.
